id: title:andehen:add facade seed helpers for outside tests

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a dedicated test-support entry point and comprehensive test assertions for the Experiments backend, allowing external test suites to construct records and validate status derivation and error handling without importing production models.
review.reason: Adds a facade module and dedicated test suite for the Experiments backend. P1.F1.H1 introduces helper functions to create, update, and delete experiment records while preserving team-scoped relationships and signal behavior. P1.F2.H1 adds assertions to validate status derivation and error handling. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in the reliability and maintain-.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of implementation and test assertions, but the actual runtime benefit or production impact is not demonstrated. No unverified outcomes are inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a facade module with helper functions to create, update, and delete experiment and holdout records, and to link saved metrics, while also adding a dedicated test suite.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a test-support entry point for the experiments backend, allowing external test suites to construct experiment and holdout records without importing production models, while preserving signal behavior and team-scoped relationships.

observations.behavior: Adds comprehensive tests for the facade helpers, including assertions on created records, status derivation, and error handling for cross-team and invalid-field operations.
observations.posthog_connection: Validates that the facade correctly derives experiment status from dates and maintains team-scoped relationships, and that it raises appropriate exceptions when supplied with invalid team or field parameters.
